NCS.notes: No NCS fan, filter, or NCS-code matching was found published on nirlat.com's color-fan tool or site search.

woodLacquerProducts.notes: Solvent-based clear polyurethane lacquer for wood furniture / renewing wood coatings. Product page lists brush/roller application; the linked technical data sheet (PDF) was not machine-readable to confirm spray/booth instructions.

Nirlat's industrial/professional arm (NirlatPro) lists two-component polyurethane and aliphatic-polyurethane topcoats, including products described for furniture painting in a range of shades/finishes. This is the more likely product family for spray/booth furniture finishing, but individual TDS pages should be checked per product for spray-gun parameters.
Nirlat's consumer-facing wood product catalog (stains, sealers, topcoats); general reference, not spray-specific.

RAL.notes: Tambour publishes a dedicated RAL fan (~212 standard RAL hues for industrial painting) with individual hue pages showing RGB/hex.

NCS.notes: No NCS fan, filter, or NCS-code matching page was found published on tambour.co.il.

woodLacquerProducts.notes: Tambour's industrial-paints category for wood, including two-component polyurethane topcoats (high-gloss, various colors) and a white two-component polyurethane wood primer.
Two-component polyurethane white primer for wood substrates (industrial line).
